basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old tech enthusiast based in Lake Arrowhead, California. I work as a software developer for a mid-sized gaming company. My interests include video games, particularly FPS games like Call of Duty, and I'm a big fan of nerdfighter culture. I love outdoor activities such as hiking and kayaking when I'm not glued to my PC. I'm in a long-term relationship and enjoy spending some of my evenings gaming with my partner. I usually check Reddit during lunch breaks and late at night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been coding since high school. I've always been passionate about technology and gaming, which led me to pursue a career in software development. I stay up-to-date with the latest tech trends through self-teaching and online courses.
